title: USB MIDI
author: irpina
description: Class-compliant USB MIDI in and out on the Octatrack's own USB port, mirroring the DIN ports, as a function of usb-ot: it combines with the other USB functions. Built on the firmware's own dormant USB-MIDI half, with what octabam found (512-byte packets at high speed, the FIFO kept from overflowing, transmit after a replug, USB clock timestamped).
